candidate_business_outcome: An administrator copies or moves a project and can identify the resulting contents, inherited settings, access and retained history.
unresolved_variants: Copy versus identity-preserving move; inherited grants after reparenting; archive versus delete; external ID changes and ordering.

candidate_business_outcome: An administrator attaches, changes or detaches shared templates and can inspect exactly which effective steps and values remain.
unresolved_variants: Ordered multiple templates; inlineSettings; optimizeSettings; default templates; local override and reset.

candidate_business_outcome: An administrator edits one item or replaces a complete settings list and later builds use exactly the accepted ordering and membership.
unresolved_variants: Replace versus merge; omitted/null/empty collections; child IDs; disabling versus deleting; unknown runner or feature types; inherited entries.

candidate_business_outcome: A developer supplies typed or inherited inputs and can distinguish configured inputs, runtime overrides, produced values and protected values.
unresolved_variants: Type/default/validation/prompting; remove override versus remove inherited value; output exposure; secure tokens and privileged value reads.

category: Versioned settings as a user workflow
candidate_business_outcome: An administrator inspects synchronization, loads accepted repository settings or commits changes and can tell which settings a new build will use.
unresolved_variants: Git-only authority versus reference synchronization disabled/current/VCS modes; inherited settings; conflict direction; Kotlin/XML fields versus deliberate C# authoring; editing permissions and load scope.

category: VCS root and observed repository state
candidate_business_outcome: An administrator creates and attaches a source connection, detects changes and repairs a failed connection without silently changing the selected source.
unresolved_variants: Root versus parameterized instance; multi-root checkout rules; polling versus hook; reset repository state; credential changes and delete-in-use; branch/submodule/LFS modes.

candidate_business_outcome: A developer sees pending changes, finds builds containing a change and follows its changed files, ancestry and linked issues.
unresolved_variants: Pending versus included versus previous-build difference; merge/duplicate commits; inaccessible roots; change identity across configurations/imports.

category: Run Custom Build and settings freeze
candidate_business_outcome: A developer chooses whether a queued build fixes its source and settings immediately or collects them when it starts, and sees the version actually used.
unresolved_variants: BuildTriggeringOptions.freezeSettings; explicit revisions/branch/Agent; personal build; clean sources; custom parameters; changing settings while queued.

candidate_business_outcome: An operator pauses new starts, changes waiting order and resumes processing without losing queued work or silently stopping running builds.
unresolved_variants: Global pause versus paused configuration/disabled Agent; position versus priority; incompatible head entry; concurrent queue edits and permission scope.

candidate_business_outcome: A protected build waits for its required reviewers, starts only after sufficient valid approval and exposes rejection or timeout.
unresolved_variants: Required users/groups/counts; chain-wide approvals; timeout; invalid rules; eligibility still applies after approval; approveAll authority.

candidate_business_outcome: A developer cancels a running build with or without requesting a replacement and can distinguish the cancelled run from the queued replacement.
unresolved_variants: readdIntoQueue only for running builds in public docs; cancellation comments; queued delete versus abort; confirmed cancellation/replacement timing and retry.

candidate_business_outcome: A developer reruns selected failed dependencies, reuses suitable successful builds when allowed and follows the exact outputs selected for downstream work.
unresolved_variants: Composite versus executing parent; reuse criteria; clean all dependencies; same-Agent affinity; revisions; failure policies; retries without duplicate publication.

category: Agent run policy independent of compatibility
candidate_business_outcome: An operator limits an otherwise suitable agent to selected configurations and can see why another configuration is refused.
unresolved_variants: CompatibilityPolicy any versus selected; empty selection; intersection with requirements, pools, authorization, enablement and explicit custom targeting.

candidate_business_outcome: An operator creates a pool, moves agents, changes project membership and retires the pool with explicit consequences for waiting and active work.
unresolved_variants: Default pool; replace versus append project membership; cross-project authorization; automatic authorization tokens; deletion and capacity semantics.

candidate_business_outcome: An operator can distinguish a registered machine, a reusable machine type and capacity that has not connected yet.
unresolved_variants: Stable type identity versus Agent/session; compatible configurations for disconnected or not-yet-started capacity; imported identity.

category: Mutable build metadata and manual outcome
candidate_business_outcome: An authorized developer annotates a build or manually changes its displayed success state while the original execution evidence remains inspectable.
unresolved_variants: Manual displayed status versus immutable raw outcome; number/counter identity; tags replace/add/remove; pin/unpin/comment lifecycle; actor and reason.

candidate_business_outcome: An authorized external reporter supplies progress, diagnostic output, problems and completion for the intended run without affecting another run.
unresolved_variants: Actual reference purpose and permission of runningData/finish/log/problem writes; built-in Agent ownership versus external reporting; late/duplicate reports and aggregate result.

candidate_business_outcome: An operator acts on a selected set and can identify which individual objects changed, failed or were inaccessible.
unresolved_variants: Selection changes during request; per-item authorization; atomic versus partial semantics; retries; never silently affect hidden or newly matched objects.

category: File trees, archives and source browsing
candidate_business_outcome: A developer browses a retained file tree, downloads a selected file or archive and distinguishes exact-build source from latest source.
unresolved_variants: Metadata/tree versus bytes; archive filters; escaped/nested paths; links/ranges; inaccessible or expired files; logs use additional non-REST routes too.

category: Test identity and rich history queries
candidate_business_outcome: A developer follows one test across configurations, branches and attempts and sees running, ignored, failed, muted and incomplete evidence distinctly.
unresolved_variants: Test versus occurrence IDs; parameterization/suite/name change; long IDs; first failure/fixed/flaky; filters and attachment/provenance limits.

candidate_business_outcome: A developer investigates a build problem or test failure, changes responsibility and ends or expires a scoped mute without erasing occurrences.
unresolved_variants: Build problem versus failed test; project/configuration scope; explicit versus when-fixed expiry; reassignment/resolution history; current rights and bulk effects.

candidate_business_outcome: A developer compares exact measurements and consumes produced values without confusing them with configured defaults or missing values.
unresolved_variants: Numeric precision/text units; output versus actual input; interpolation and secret masking; custom statistics and running/final consistency.

category: Build features, publication and VCS labels
candidate_business_outcome: A configured integration publishes the intended status, label or release once and exposes failures instead of merely accepting its settings.
unresolved_variants: Feature property bags hide real runner/trigger/integration semantics; credentials; notification/issue tracker/status publisher behavior; retries and coexistence ownership.

candidate_business_outcome: An administrator creates, changes and removes accounts, nested groups and roles and sees the resulting current access without changing another scope.
unresolved_variants: Append versus replace assignments/memberships; cyclic includes; built-in deletion; provider-only versus password accounts; All Users/guest modes; last-admin behavior.

candidate_business_outcome: Existing automation authenticates using its supported credential form and a build can retrieve only the resources allowed to its temporary build identity.
unresolved_variants: Bearer, Basic/httpAuth, guestAuth, cookie/session reuse, empty-username superuser and build-scoped credentials; Depot OIDC does not prove these forms; forced user logout versus local logout.

category: User preferences, avatars and credential metadata
candidate_business_outcome: A person manages their profile and named credentials and an authorized administrator can terminate the supported remembered access without altering retained build ownership.
unresolved_variants: Self versus other-user permissions; token name/expiry/scope metadata; avatar update/cache/removal; property replacement; remember-me versus all sessions/tokens.

candidate_business_outcome: A release operator records what build is deployed to each environment and can inspect its deployment history independently of a build merely succeeding.
unresolved_variants: Dashboard/instance lifecycle; deployment build identity and timing; replacement versus history; delete behavior and rights; existing publisher import mapping.

candidate_business_outcome: An authorized operator starts or stops required build capacity and distinguishes requested capacity, connected agents and a failed provider operation.
unresolved_variants: Source profile/driver usage; normal versus forced stop during work; quotas and project rights; map to real providers rather than fabricate success or declare all cloud optional.
delivery_gate: Required family before R6; adapter milestone must be allocated

category: Backup, cleanup and privileged server files
candidate_business_outcome: An operator requests and follows a backup, changes cleanup policy and retrieves authorized diagnostics with truthful completion and removal consequences.
unresolved_variants: Asynchronous operation/error/single-flight; supported backup contents versus source format; server file areas and private startup password disclosure; scheduled cleanup versus immediate deletion.

candidate_business_outcome: An operator traces a change to its actor, identifies an actionable health problem and distinguishes a missing measurement from a healthy zero.
unresolved_variants: Categories/targets/resolution; current permissions and redaction; time and metric units; retained audit visibility and pagination; no copied fake TeamCity diagnostics.

candidate_business_outcome: Existing administration clients discover real capabilities and can distinguish supported server operations from operations that have no mapped product behavior.
unresolved_variants: Compatibility version versus product identity; JVM plugins/license keys versus OSS C# Host; single-node topology/responsibilities and global settings; unresolved scope is not a no-op success or automatic exemption.
delivery_gate: R0 discovery; R5 remaining disposition; no first-time model decision in R5

candidate_business_outcome: An existing client finds every matching visible object across pages and follows its links without seeing objects outside its access.
unresolved_variants: Locator semantics; defaults include/exclude personal/cancelled/history; next page after empty count; search limits; fields and null/absent values; renamed/imported IDs and local links.

candidate_business_outcome: An operator can distinguish a deliberate second run from recovery of an uncertain request and sees when a settings change actually became effective.
unresolved_variants: Explicit native retry identity versus unkeyed compatible requests; reference queue optimization/reuse versus invented body-hash deduplication; intent may be unknowable; Git activation/read-after-write and current authorization.

candidate_business_outcome: An administrator knows the effects of deleting the selected object, including dependent work and history, and unrelated or protected data is not silently removed.
unresolved_variants: The words supported removal and agreed policy are not an oracle; inactive Agent versus idle Agent; cascade/restore; pinned build versus explicit deletion; source cleanup versus target explicit delete.

category: Runtime semantics hidden behind REST settings
candidate_business_outcome: A migrated configuration actually builds, reports tests and performs its configured side effects under the same rules as its original system.
unresolved_variants: REST inventory does not enumerate every runner/feature/trigger/property behavior, service message, agent protocol, workload environment or non-REST log/artifact route; derive from fleet and producers too.

candidate_business_outcome: An operator imports retained history with its links, attribution and original files and later updates it without duplicating objects or reactivating side effects.
unresolved_variants: Deleted/archived source parents; current source user versus historical actor; complete relations beyond builds/files; identity mapping, privileged/unexportable secrets, version capabilities and source changes during paging.
